sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Affordable, stylish eyewear with a strong online presence, customer-friendly policies (free shipping, 30-day returns), acceptance of vision benefits, and a focus on both eyeglasses and contact lenses.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Warby Parker is an online and brick-and-mortar retailer offering prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses. They focus on providing stylish, high-quality eyewear at affordable prices, coupled with customer-friendly services like free shipping, free returns, and vision benefits acceptance.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Prescription eyeglasses
non-prescription sunglasses
and contact lenses.

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Fixed price per pair of eyeglasses/sunglasses (e.g., $95), with discounts on initial contact lens orders.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Consumers seeking stylish and affordable vision correction or sun protection, including students and individuals leveraging vision benefits.
